correctness.rationale: Read complete proof and independently checked the phase-Jacobian transverse spectrum. A=1+2r+3s, B=-1+2r-3s, C=-1/2-r+3s, with nontrivial modes synchrony -3gA (double), splay -3gC (double), pacemaker -g(2A+B),-3gB. Strict positivity reduces to r>3/2 and the stated open interval. At B=0 potential has strict local minimum with quadratic intra-pair term 2r*v² and quartic intercluster (5r-4)*u⁴/6; LaSalle/isolated critical points give attraction but not exponential rate. On pair manifold u_dot=-g(5r-4)u³+O(u⁵), hence t*u²->1/[2g(5r-4)]. At C=0 independently expanded splay potential cubic sqrt3*(4r-1)/4*u*v*(u-v), sign indefinite, forbidding gradient attractor. Verified H third derivative at pi =10r-8 via SymPy and first-order IFT lag derivative (A-B)/(3B) in strict cone. No statement that 6 exhaust all sinks or that phase shift is a true DDE delay.
